APPROVE
The refactor keeps the original logic: it filters out print rules, applies the same Raw, Key and Universal targeting split for the removing rule versus other rules, and short-circuits the same DrawsIndicator/Outranks checks per declaration; it cuts the method's cognitive complexity to roughly 7, and it uses only constructs (LINQ was already imported for `Select`, all parameters are used) that compile cleanly with warnings as errors.
